description: Update a Page — rename, set icon, replace the body, or archive/unarchive (archived:true hides it, false restores it). `body` is plain text (blank lines → paragraphs) and REPLACES the page content. Omitted fields are unchanged. Resolve the id via list_pages; only id is required.

archived.description: true archives (hides) the page; false restores it (optional).

body.description: New content as plain text; blank lines separate paragraphs. REPLACES existing content (optional).

icon.description: New emoji icon; null clears it (optional).

name: update_page
title: Update Page
